name: Phenescaline
summary: Phenescaline, also known as 3,5-dimethoxy-4-phenylethoxyphenethylamine, is a psychoactive drug of the phenethylamine and scaline families related to mescaline. It is the derivative of mescaline in which the methoxy group at the 4 position has been replaced with a phenylethoxy group.

pharmacology.text: The drug shows affinity for the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor (Ki = 59 nM).

uses.en: It has no medical use and is known from the chemical literature on mescaline analogues.
uses.zh: 它沒有醫療用途，見於麥司卡林類似物的化學文獻中。
uses.zhHans: 它没有医疗用途，见于麦司卡林类似物的化学文献中。

fact.en: The scalines are mescaline molecules with the middle methoxy group swapped for something longer. Alexander Shulgin made and described many of them in his book PiHKAL.
fact.zh: 「scaline」系列是把麥司卡林中間的甲氧基換成更長基團的衍生物。亞歷山大．舒爾金合成了許多這類化合物，並在《PiHKAL》中加以描述。
fact.zhHans: 「scaline」系列是把麦司卡林中间的甲氧基换成更长基团的衍生物。亚历山大．舒尔金合成了许多这类化合物，并在《PiHKAL》中加以描述。
